q: This paper provides practitioners with a comprehensive guide to SDD, covering its principles, workflow patterns, and supporting tools.
r: Include: practitioner guide to SDD with AI coding assistants and tools such as Spec Kit; group (a), not a short or position piece (about 39k characters, case studies).

q: Spec Kit Agents, a multi-agent SDD pipeline (statemachine orchestrator + PM and developer roles)
r: Include: multi-agent SDD pipeline on Spec Kit evaluated over 128 runs with baseline and ablation configurations; group (a).

q: We term this convergence Spec-Driven Agentic Development
sec: 1.2 Co-evolution of Methodology and Model Scale, p. 4
r: Include: proposes the SDAD spec-driven agentic development framework with metrics and economics; group (a), full-length paper.

q: We presented the Spec Growth Engine, a lean framework for AI-assisted software development
r: Include: spec-anchored framework (spec graph, context assembler, drift gate) for AI coding agents; group (a).

q: This paper investigates cross-agent specification portability using Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration as a controlled software transformation task.
r: Include: controlled experiment on specification-driven generation across different coding agents (1,006 PL/SQL files); group (a).

q: we collected and analyzed three sources largely in parallel
r: Include: empirical study of SDD in practice (Reddit, 21 interviews, 266 repositories) with coding agents; group (a).

r: Include: conceptual and multivocal-literature study of SDD as a discipline for agentic software engineering, with the harness mechanisms; group (a).

r: Include: spec-driven AI-SDLC with repository-local instruction files for coding agents, evaluated by a student survey (12 respondents); groups (a) and (b), small but a full paper.

q: EPIC, an empirically grounded framework of 40 specification practices for SDD artifacts
r: Include: empirically derived framework for SDD specification quality (114 repositories, practitioner assessment) used by coding agents; group (a).

q: This paper presents an end-to-end architecture for agentauthored, formally verified software engineering.
r: Include: spec-first architecture where autonomous coding agents synthesise code and proofs from specifications; formal methods but with coding agents, so EC2 does not apply; conceptual with case studies.
